name: codebase-agentic-readiness-framework-dev-tools
description: The Node dev tools of this repository, as exact versions. Nothing installs this file: the Makefile and dev/mermaid_check.py read each version from here and run the tool through npx. It exists so that Dependabot (the npm entry for /dev/tools in .github/dependabot.yml) sees the tools and, through package-lock.json, their dependencies. After a change, run `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` in dev/tools. dev/tests/test_tool_pins.py checks that every version is exact.
